objective: Test whether adding a rolling long-tail HEDGE (a monthly long SPY put) on top of the v5 short-premium book reduces the residual 2022 bear loss, and at what carry cost in calm years. v5 is the champion; this asks whether the hedge is worth it.
design_note: This is a PORTFOLIO RISK OVERLAY, not a new set of gate trials. The v5 book's per-trade gate is unchanged. The hedge is reported at the annual (pooled) level: book PnL + hedge PnL = net. No promotion claim rides on the hedge.

hedge.cadence: open one long put on the first trading day of each month; hold to expiry; roll monthly
hedge.dte: nearest monthly third-Friday to 45 DTE within 30-60
hedge.pricing: Black-Scholes with sigma = VIX/100 at entry, r = 4% (VIX is real, so the hedge gets expensive exactly when it is most wanted)
hedge.settlement: intrinsic max(strike - S_expiry, 0) * 100 at expiry; cost = entry premium * 100 + fixed per-leg cost
hedge.size: one contract per month (comparable to the desk's 1-lot candidates)

hypothesis: The hedge bleeds a small, roughly constant carry in calm years (2019-2021, 2024-2026) and pays enough in 2022 to cut that year's loss, improving worst-year drawdown even if it lowers total return.
known_risk_to_the_thesis: 2022 was a GRINDING bear (slow bleed), not a gap crash like March 2020. A 45-DTE 7%-OTM put may expire worthless repeatedly during a grind and only pay in the sharp legs. It is entirely possible the hedge helps 2020 (a real crash) but NOT 2022 -- that would be an honest and useful finding.
falsifiable_predictions: 2022 net loss (book + hedge) is smaller than v5's -$2802
every calm year is worse by the hedge carry (a small negative drag)
the hedge's own total PnL over 2019-2026 is negative (tail hedges usually have negative expected value; they buy drawdown reduction, not return)

guardrails.no_p_hacking: Registered ONCE with the strike (7% OTM), DTE (45), cadence (monthly), and size (1 lot) fixed before running. If the hedge does not help, we report it and keep v5 unhedged. We do not sweep strike/DTE/size to find a version that pays.
guardrails.gate_unchanged: The v5 book gate is untouched; the hedge is an overlay, not a gate trial.
guardrails.same_deviations: Proxied/model pricing carries over; the hedge is BS-priced on the SPY path -> an approximation, not real fills.

promotion: No promotion. Determines whether a tail hedge is worth proposing alongside a future live desk. SHADOW throughout.
